status: Selection closed; sealed holdout not yet executed
challenger_role: Best non-baseline arm in the final paired gate-aware selection pool, evaluated once as an independent negative-control comparison; it is not a validated shipping proposal.
final_pool: Baseline plus nine data-driven challengers, each evaluated on all eight records and all six training/refinement seeds: 480 paired case results, with controls and previously completed cases reused.

best_unpenalized_interior.decision: Rejected by unchanged deterministic quality gates, despite improved pitch and accelerometer-bias metrics.

boundary_resolution: The completed extended four-dimensional grid moved the X optimum into the interior at approximately 0.75 and the Y optimum near 1.3-1.4. Separate sigma brackets at 1.0, 1.1, 1.2 and 1.4 turned over at 1.1 for the rounded interior point. Equal-product symmetric and reversed-X/Y controls showed the anisotropy effect is not only a regularization-scale effect.
